# 查询手续费率 (USER\_DATA)

- **GET** `/capi/v3/account/commissionRate`

权重(IP): 5

**请求参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 是否必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| symbol | String | 是 | 交易对 |

**请求示例**

```
curl "https://api-contract.weex.com/capi/v3/account/commissionRate?symbol=BTCUSDT" \
   -H "ACCESS-KEY:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-SIGN:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-PASSPHRASE:*****" \
   -H "ACCESS-TIMESTAMP:1659076670000" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

**返回参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| symbol | String | 交易对 |
| makerCommissionRate | String | Maker 手续费率，例如 0.0002 表示 0.02% |
| takerCommissionRate | String | Taker 手续费率，例如 0.0004 表示 0.04% |

**返回示例**

```
{
  "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
  "makerCommissionRate": "0.0002",
  "takerCommissionRate": "0.0004"
}
```
